info.title: Kijk API
info.description: Kijk API to manage your houses

get.summary: Gets the accounts of the active space

post.summary: Creates an account; shared accounts additionally require finances:configure

put.summary: Updates an account; shared accounts additionally require finances:configure

delete.summary: Deletes an account without transactions; shared accounts additionally require finances:configure

get.summary: Gets all budget versions of the active space

post.summary: Creates a budget for a category from a month on; shared budgets additionally require budgets:plan

get.summary: Gets the spending per category over several months
Evaluates the budgets for a calendar month

put.summary: Updates a budget version; shared budgets additionally require budgets:plan

delete.summary: Deletes a budget version; shared budgets additionally require budgets:plan

get.summary: Gets the categories available to the active space
Gets the remembered category corrections of the active space
Suggests rules from repeated manual corrections; remembering the suggested transaction's category creates the rule
Gets a consumption by id
Exports a consumption as CSV
Exports all consumptions for a month as CSV
Gets all consumptions for the current user by year, month and type
Gets all consumptions stats
Gets all years
Gets the latest imports of the active space

post.summary: Uploads a bank export and starts its import

get.summary: Gets an import by id
Gets the first rows of an uploaded file for the column mapping
Gets the rows of an import waiting for review

post.summary: Confirms the column mapping and starts reading the file

put.summary: Changes the category or exclusion of a row during the review

get.summary: Gets exactly the texts the AI categorization would send

put.summary: Deselects or selects a text of the AI preview

post.summary: Proposes categories with the AI for the rows that have none
Replaces the account's transactions in the covered months with the reviewed rows
Cancels an open import and deletes its file

get.summary: Gets the import settings of the active space

put.summary: Changes the import settings of the active space

get.summary: Gets consumption limits for the active space
Gets a consumption limit by id
Gets all resources
Gets a resource type

delete.summary: Deletes an unused custom resource type

get.summary: Gets the space roles and their permissions

delete.summary: Deletes a space and its data

get.summary: Gets the members of a space with their roles

put.summary: Changes the role of another space member

get.summary: Gets transactions of the active space, optionally by year, month or without category
Exports transactions as CSV, optionally by year, month or without category
Gets a transaction by id

put.summary: Assigns one category to several transactions
Corrects the category of a transaction, optionally remembering it for the merchant or counterparty

get.summary: Gets units visible to the current user
Gets supported system units
Gets a page of units for settings

put.summary: Shares a unit with a space

delete.summary: Removes a unit from a space

get.summary: Gets me

put.summary: Switches the active space of the current user
Completes onboarding and creates the Kijk account when needed

AccountKind.description: Represents the kind of a space account.

ibanLast4.description: The last four characters of the IBAN, if known.

kind.description: Whether it is a bank account or the cash account.

AccountResponse.description: A bank account of the space.

AiDataSharing.description: Represents which transaction data a space lets the AI categorization see.

key.description: The id of the text within the import.

incoming.description: Whether money came in; the amount itself is never sent.

rowCount.description: The number of rows that share the text.

excluded.description: Whether the user deselected the text.

AiPreviewItemResponse.description: A distinct text the AI categorization would send.

withheldRows.description: Rows without a category that are not sent because nothing useful remains after cleaning.

AiPreviewResponse.description: What the AI categorization of an import would send.

budgetId.description: The applicable budget version, if any.

budget.description: The applicable monthly amount, if any.

pending.description: Pending expenses that do not count yet.

remaining.description: The amount left, if a budget applies.

utilizationPercentage.description: The used share of the budget in percent, if a budget applies.

isExceeded.description: Whether the spending is over the budget.

oneOf.description: Whether the applicable budget is shared or the member's private one.

BudgetCategoryResponse.description: The spending of an expense category in the evaluated month.

totalBudget.description: The sum of all active budgets.

totalSpent.description: All booked expenses minus refunds, including uncategorized expenses.

uncategorizedIncome.description: Booked incoming payments without a category.

pendingExpenses.description: Expenses the bank has not booked yet; they do not count against budgets.

categories.description: The expense categories with an active budget or with transactions in the month.

BudgetOverviewResponse.description: The budget evaluation of a month.

validFrom.description: The first day of the first month the budget applies to.

visibility.description: Whether the budget belongs to the whole space or only to the current member.

BudgetResponse.description: A budget version: a monthly amount for a category from a month on.

months.description: The first day of each month, oldest first.

categories.description: The expense categories with spending or a budget in at least one month.

uncategorized.description: Booked expenses without a category per month.

totalSpent.description: All booked expenses minus refunds per month, including uncategorized ones.

totalBudget.description: The sum of all active budgets per month.

BudgetStatisticsResponse.description: Spending per expense category over several months.

oneOf.description: Which data the AI may see for this import; the space's level when omitted.

CategorizeImportRequest.description: Request for categorizing the rows of an import with the AI.

categoryId.description: The category, or `null` to mark the transaction as uncategorized.

remember.description:
`false` corrects only this transaction. `true` also remembers the category for this
        merchant or counterparty, applies it to its other automatically categorized transactions and to future imports.

keyword.description:
With Remember: remembers the category for all bookings whose purpose contains this word
(one of IReadOnlyList<string> TransactionResponse.RememberKeywords) instead of for the merchant or counterparty.

CategorizeTransactionRequest.description: Request for correcting the category of a transaction.

appliedToOthers.description: The number of other transactions that got the remembered category.

categoryId.description: The category, or `null` to mark them as uncategorized.

CategorizeTransactionsRequest.description: Request for assigning one category to several transactions, e.g. from the list of uncategorized transactions.

CategorizeTransactionsResponse.description: The result of assigning a category to several transactions.

CategoryKind.description: Represents whether a category groups expenses or income.

kind.description: Whether the category groups expenses or income.

creatorType.description: Whether it is a system or a custom category.

CategoryResponse.description: A category that transactions and budgets can be assigned to.

label.description: The counterparty name shown when the rule was created.

visibility.description: Whether the rule applies to the whole space or only to the member's private accounts.

CategoryRuleScope.description: Represents what a category rule matches on.

id.description: A stable id of the suggestion, e.g. for hiding it.

scope.description: What the rule would match on.

label.description: The merchant or counterparty as shown in the transactions.

manualCount.description: How often the category was set by hand.

uncategorizedCount.description: How many transactions without category the rule would categorize right away.

transactionId.description: The latest transaction categorized by hand; remembering its category creates the rule.

CategoryRuleSuggestionResponse.description: A rule Kijk suggests because a member set the same category for a merchant or counterparty by hand.

spent.description: Booked expenses minus refunds per month, aligned with the months of the response.

budget.description: The active budget per month, or `null` where none applies.

CategoryTrendResponse.description: The spending of an expense category per month.

roleId.description: The identifier of the new role.

ChangeMemberRoleRequest.description: Contains the new role of a space member.

includedEdgeMonths.description: Edge months the file covers completely and that should be replaced too.

acceptErrors.description: Confirms committing although many rows could not be parsed.

ConsumptionResourceResponse.description: The resource of a consumption entry.

valueType.description: Whether Value is a meter reading or a relative value.

startsNewMeterSegment.description: Whether the reading starts a new meter segment.

calculatedConsumption.description: The normalized consumption of this entry.

calculatedMeterReading.description: The effective cumulative meter reading after applying this entry, when an absolute baseline exists.

ConsumptionStatsResourceResponse.description: The resource a statistic belongs to.

yearAverage.description: Average monthly total of the selected year (months with entries only).

yearMin.description: Lowest monthly total of the selected year.

yearMax.description: Highest monthly total of the selected year.

comparisonYear.description: Total of the comparison year (previous year for the current year, otherwise the current year).

comparisonYearDiff.description: Difference between the selected and the comparison year.

comparisonMonth.description: Total of the comparison month (previous month for the current month, otherwise the current month).

comparisonMonthDiff.description: Difference between the selected and the comparison month.

ConsumptionStatsResponse.description: Consumption statistics of one resource for the selected year and month.

ConsumptionValueType.description: Describes how a consumption value was entered.

validFrom.description: Any day of the first month the budget applies to.

visibility.description: A private budget is seen and used only by its creator and replaces the shared budget of the category for them.

CreateBudgetRequest.description: Request for creating a budget for a category from a month on.

CreateCategoryRequest.description: Request for creating a custom category.

valueType.description: Whether Value is a meter reading or the consumed amount.

startsNewMeterSegment.description: Whether a meter reading starts a new segment, e.g. after a meter replacement.

CreateConsumptionRequest.description: The data of a new consumption.

CreateConsumptionValueTypes.description: How the entered value of a consumption is interpreted.

CreateLimitRequest.description: Request for creating a consumption limit.

CreateResourceRequest.description: Command to create a new resource type.

amount.description: The signed amount in EUR; negative values are expenses.

status.description: Whether the transaction is booked or pending.

isTransfer.description: Whether it is a transfer between the space's own accounts.

categoryId.description: The category, or `null` to leave it uncategorized.

CreateTransactionRequest.description: Request for recording a transaction manually.

CreatorType.description: Represents who was the creator of the object.

headerRowIndex.description: The 0-based index of the header among the non-empty records; records above it are metadata and ignored.

dateFormat.description: The date format, one of IReadOnlyList<string> CsvImportMapping.DateFormats.

amountColumn.description: The signed amount column; alternatively use debit and credit columns.

debitColumn.description: The column with outgoing amounts, if the export splits them.

creditColumn.description: The column with incoming amounts, if the export splits them.

counterpartyColumn.description: The payee, or the counterparty of all bookings.

payerColumn.description: The payer, used for incoming payments when the export has separate columns.

bankReferenceColumn.description: A unique booking id of the bank, if the export has one.

statusColumn.description: A column that marks pending bookings.

bookingTypeColumn.description: The booking type, e.g. "Lastschrift" or "Überweisung"; marks card payments and direct debits.

CsvImportMapping.description:
Describes how the columns of a bank export map to transaction fields. Only declarative options, never code.
Column indexes are 0-based.

user.description: Gets the persisted Kijk user when the account is ready.

CurrentUserResponse.description: Represents the current account while preventing invalid account-state combinations.

CurrentUserStatus.description: Describes the account state for the authenticated Clerk identity.

fullName.description: The full name, or null when its use is disabled.

imageUrl.description: The profile image URL, or null when its use is disabled.

ExternalIdentityResponse.description: Identity data owned by the authentication provider and exposed according to the user's preference.

onboardingCompleted.description: Gets whether the user has completed onboarding.

useExternalProfile.description: Gets whether Kijk may use the external full name and profile image.

oneOf.description: Gets identity data supplied by the authentication provider.

GetMeUserResponse.description: Represents the persisted Kijk user data for a ready account.

GetStatsConsumptionsResponseWrapper.description: Consumption statistics of the active space.

GetYearsConsumptionQueryResponse.description: The years with consumptions in the active space.

rowNumber.description: The record number in the file.

status.description: Whether the booking is booked or pending.

errors.description: Why the row could not be parsed.

excluded.description: Whether the row will not be imported.

isCardSettlement.description: Whether the row looks like a credit card statement.

countsAsOffset.description: Whether the card statement only offsets separately imported purchases.

ImportCandidateResponse.description: A row of an import waiting for review.

processedRows.description: The number of rows read so far.

errorCount.description: The number of rows that could not be parsed.

importedCount.description: The number of transactions created by the commit.

hasHighErrorRate.description: Whether committing needs an explicit confirmation because too many rows failed.

error.description: Why the import failed, without file content.

oneOf.description: The proposed mapping, while the import waits for one.

aiUnavailable.description: Whether the AI format detection could not be reached, so a weaker proposal is shown.

aiDataSharing.description: Which data the AI categorization of this import may see.

aiCategorizedCount.description: The number of rows the AI categorized in the last run.

aiCategorizationUnavailable.description: Whether the AI could not be reached, so some rows stay uncategorized.

fullMonths.description: Months the file covers completely; committing replaces them.

edgeMonths.description: The first and last month, which the file may cover only partly.

skippedMonths.description: Edge months the user did not import.

completedAt.description: When the import was committed, cancelled or failed.

ImportJobStatus.description: Represents the processing state of a CSV import.

encoding.description: The encoding used to decode the file.

delimiter.description: The delimiter used to split it.

headerRowIndex.description: The index of the header among the non-empty records.

recordCount.description: The number of non-empty records in the file.

ImportPreviewResponse.description: The first rows of an uploaded file, for choosing the column mapping.

purposeRetention.description: How much of the purpose text imported transactions keep.

aiDataSharing.description: Which transaction data the AI categorization may see.

minimizeData.description: Whether imports store neither names of private persons nor counterparty keys.

ImportSettingsResponse.description: The import settings of the active space.

LimitResourceResponse.description: The resource governed by a consumption limit.

LimitResponse.description: A consumption limit together with its current evaluation data.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the error occurred.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID for the request.

quantityKey.description: The physical quantity of the unit.

creatorType.description: Whether it is a system or a custom resource.

ResourceResponse.description: A resource that consumptions can be recorded for.

role.description: The member's role in the space.

isCurrentUser.description: Whether the member is the current user.

permissions.description: The permission names granted by the role.

SpaceRoleResponse.description: A space role and the permissions it grants.

spaceId.description: The space to switch to; the user must be a member.

SwitchSpaceRequest.description: Request for switching the active space of the current user.

amount.description: The signed amount; negative values are expenses.

status.description: Whether the transaction is booked or pending.

isTransfer.description: Whether it is a transfer between the space's own accounts.

oneOf.description: How the category was assigned, if categorized.
